methods.numerical: Two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov statistic and p-value; PSI using reference-period quantile bins with missingness as an explicit bin.
methods.categorical: Squared Jensen-Shannon distance (base 2), including missing values as a category.

interpretation_note: These are descriptive feature-distribution comparisons. They measure changes in P(X), not concept drift in P(Y|X). KS p-values are sample-size sensitive and should not be interpreted alone.
